name: Clean product UI visual and intent rubric
score_type: Model-estimated proxy; not human preference or validated beauty prediction

anchors.1: Major visual breakdowns obscure the task
anchors.2: Rough or unfinished; weak hierarchy, arbitrary spacing, or generic uncomposed output
anchors.3: Competent and readable, with visible inconsistencies or limited polish
anchors.4: Coherent, polished, intentional, and well fitted to the task and declared style
anchors.5: Exceptional clarity and craft with distinctive, appropriate detail

criteria.hierarchy: The task, current context, primary action and supporting information have an intelligible order of emphasis.
criteria.typography: Readable body text, deliberate scale and weight, restrained font choices, and appropriate line lengths.
criteria.spacing_alignment: Consistent spacing and shared alignments; related elements grouped together; neither cramped nor arbitrarily empty.
criteria.color_restraint: Purposeful palette, clear emphasis and legible states; quiet decoration without low-contrast text.
criteria.composition_coherence: A complete, balanced composition for this task, with consistent surfaces and controls; useful content rather than filler.
criteria.responsive_composition: Mobile is intentionally recomposed, with clear priority and usable controls, rather than a squeezed desktop.
criteria.intent_alignment: The visible design expresses the actual requested descriptors and audience needs; generic prettiness does not substitute for intent.

important_distinctions: Do not infer working interactions, accessibility conformance or user satisfaction from pixels.
Do not reward decoration, gradients, complexity or a dashboard shell by themselves.
A focused form can be excellent without a sidebar; a workflow screen should not become a bare test control surrounded by accidental empty space.
Explicit user descriptors override generic style defaults. Report ambiguity rather than silently replacing unusual descriptors.
Keep failed measurements as hard blockers regardless of visual score.
source_usage: Principles summarized and interpreted for this project; no copied guide text, screenshots or source material used for model training.
